entities.name: Alberto Chissano
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Alberto Mabungulane Chissano was a Mozambican sculptor best known for his work using indigenous woods, and sculptures in rock, stone and iron. He is considered to be one of Mozambique's most important and influential artists, together with the painter 
Malangatana Ngwenya.
